hooks.prompt: A `firebase deploy` just ran in this repo. Compare CLAUDE.md against the current state of the codebase (schedule-manager.html, worker-punch.html, service-worker.js, manifest.json, manifest-punch.json, firebase.json, .firebaserc) and update CLAUDE.md if anything is stale or missing: new commands, changed architecture/data flow, new top-level files, or a bumped service-worker cache version worth noting. Only edit CLAUDE.md if something actually changed since it was last written; otherwise do nothing and exit quietly.
